title: ‘I see the incredible promise’: on set of an AI film shoot as new studios embrace controversial tech

paragraphs.en: Near the collonaded entrance to Sony Pictures’ historic Culver City film studio, a tech-powered rival has sprung up this summer. The artists at Promise, a new studio feeding off the potential of AI, can glimpse the lots where Singin’ in the Rain and Men in Black were shot, but no longer do they need to get beyond the studio’s high walls to make their visions come true.
paragraphs.zh: 在索尼影业历史悠久的卡尔弗城制片厂带柱廊的大门附近，一家由科技驱动的新对手今年夏天悄然崛起。Promise 是一家依托 AI 潜力成立的新制片厂，在这里工作的艺术家们可以瞥见《雨中曲》和《黑衣人》拍摄时的片场，但他们不再需要越过片场的高墙就能让自己的想象成真。

paragraphs.en: From far more modest premises, they are making movies with rapidly accelerating AI models that create backgrounds, special effects and even “synthetic performers” – using US models but also driven by market-leading Chinese AI.
paragraphs.zh: 在简陋得多的办公场所里，他们正在用飞速发展的 AI 模型制作电影，这些模型可以生成背景、特效，甚至“合成演员”——既使用美国模型，也借助市场领先的中国 AI。

paragraphs.en: Backed by Google, Silicon Valley venture capitalists and Disney, Promise is one of a rising number of AI film studios now taking root in Hollywood, with the result that traditional studios’ vast sound stages and financing are becoming less necessary.
paragraphs.zh: Promise 得到了谷歌、硅谷风险投资家和迪士尼的支持，是如今在好莱坞扎根的日益增多的 AI 电影制片厂之一，其结果是，传统制片厂庞大的摄影棚和融资变得不那么必要了。

paragraphs.en: It is a controversial trend. Leading directors including Christopher Nolan and Guillermo del Toro have criticised generative technology, actors and writers are fearing for their jobs, and the Democratic congresswoman Laura Friedman, who represents Hollywood’s actors, writers and directors, warned last month: “We can’t wait until we see tens of thousands of American workers displaced.”
paragraphs.zh: 这是一股颇具争议的潮流。包括克里斯托弗·诺兰和吉列尔莫·德尔·托罗在内的知名导演都批评过生成式技术，演员和编剧正为饭碗担忧，而代表好莱坞演员、编剧和导演的民主党众议员劳拉·弗里德曼上个月警告说：“我们不能等到看到成千上万美国工人失业时才行动。”

paragraphs.en: But the excitement and energy about AI’s potential was palpable this week at Promise’s new base when a human actor, Tori Thomas, waited for her call amid rows of computers for early shooting on the studio’s newly announced AI-enabled horror film, Touch Grass, with a budget in the low millions of dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 但本周在 Promise 的新基地，人们对 AI 潜力的兴奋与热情确实扑面而来：人类演员托里·托马斯坐在一排排电脑之间等待开拍，这是制片厂新近宣布的由 AI 辅助拍摄的恐怖片《Touch Grass》的前期拍摄，预算为数百万美元级别。

paragraphs.en: The sound stage was little more than a corner of the office hung with white sheets. A small camera followed Thomas as she scrambled in a chase scene, then the AI did the rest. It superimposed her movement in real time on to a field of swaying grass generated by a Chinese AI model, Seedance 2.5, released this month, which looks set to dramatically slash production times.
paragraphs.zh: 这个摄影棚不过是办公室里挂满白色幕布的一角。一台小摄像机跟随托马斯在追逐戏中奔跑，剩下的交给 AI 完成。AI 将她的动作实时叠加到一片摇曳的草地上，这片草地的画面由本月发布的中国 AI 模型 Seedance 2.5 生成，该模型看来将大幅缩短制作时间。

paragraphs.en: Whole scenes – actor and backdrop – were instantly visible on the director’s handheld monitor, as if they were filming in real locations. Even the seedheads in the AI-generated meadow moved as Thomas appeared to brush past. In another take, the field was easily replaced by a nightmarish underground cavern. With a glance at the screen, Thomas could immediately see the backdrop she was acting with.
paragraphs.zh: 整个场景——演员和背景——都立即呈现在导演手中的监视器上，仿佛他们是在真实的外景地拍摄。连 AI 生成的草地里的草穗，也会在托马斯看似擦身而过时随之摆动。在另一个镜头中，草地轻易地被换成了一个噩梦般的地下洞穴。托马斯只要看一眼屏幕，就能立刻看到她正在对戏的背景。

paragraphs.en: Promise is not alone in embracing the technology, which Netflix last week said it had used in 300 of its 1,000 titles in 2026. Ron Howard, the veteran director of the Da Vinci Code and A Beautiful Mind, is set to release an AI-enabled animated documentary feature about prisoners of war in Vietnam, working with another new AI studio, Obsidian. Brad Pitt said this week that while there was a lot of pushback, “AI is going to be the very thing that, if used as a tool, is going to help these mid-budget films, $40m- to $90m-budgeted films, get made.”
paragraphs.zh: 接受这项技术的并非只有 Promise。Netflix 上周表示，2026 年其 1000 部作品中已有 300 部使用了 AI。《达·芬奇密码》和《美丽心灵》的资深导演朗·霍华德将与另一家新 AI 制片厂 Obsidian 合作，推出一部关于越南战俘的 AI 辅助动画纪录片。布拉德·皮特本周表示，尽管阻力很大，“AI 恰恰会成为这样一种东西——如果把它当作工具来用，它将帮助那些中等预算的电影，即预算在 4000 万到 9000 万美元之间的电影，得以问世。”
